files.title: TYLER poster
files.alt: Space Monkey escape-room poster "TYLER": a line-drawn astronaut floating in front of the Earth on a starfield, title in brushed-metal condensed capitals.
files.source: C:/Users/User/Downloads/TYLER.jpg (1729x2580, Adobe RGB -> converted to sRGB; file metadata: Adobe Photoshop CS6 (Windows), created 2017-12-08, last saved 2017-12-08)
files.palette_note: near-monochrome: space black/navy + silver-grey suit + one accent family (the ocean blues of the Earth, only ~3% of the pixels are saturated)

files.title: SMITH poster
files.alt: Space Monkey escape-room poster "SMITH": a stern cartoon sergeant in a royal-blue uniform with yellow epaulettes in front of a space-shuttle launch hangar, title in chrome capitals.
files.source: C:/Users/User/Downloads/SMITH 2.jpg (1729x2551, Adobe RGB -> converted to sRGB; file metadata: Adobe Photoshop CS6 (Windows), created 2017-12-13, last saved 2017-12-20)
files.palette_note: royal blue (uniform) against burnt-orange/brown industrial hangar; yellow epaulettes + gold hat badge as small accents

files.title: Monkey head patch (from SMITH sleeve)
files.alt: Round badge: a tan-and-white cartoon monkey head with big eyes and an open smile, wearing a headset with microphone, inside a black helmet ring.
files.source: SMITH poster, sleeve patch (crop 220x200 at x1130,y960 of the 1729x2551 original)
files.method: colour-keyed from the flat blue sleeve; 2 thin ink lines crossing the patch removed (Telea inpainting); blue slivers/fringe removed; edge band recoloured to the rim colour
files.note: native size = poster pixels (no extra detail exists); tilted about 12 deg counter-clockwise on the poster (CSS rotate(12deg) levels the headset); the black rim/headset disappears on near-black backgrounds

files.title: Monkey head patch, 3x smooth upscale of the above
files.note: Lanczos 3x + light unsharp; same information as the 1x file

files.title: MONKEY roomescape mark (from TYLER chest)
files.alt: Mark printed on the astronaut suit: monkey astronaut head in a black helmet ring, a pale-blue rocket body with tan nose cone and orange fins, the word MONKEY in bold dark capitals and ROOMESCAPE in small spaced capitals.
files.source: TYLER poster, chest mark (crop 220x180 at x650,y1060 of the 1729x2580 original)
files.method: multiply-blend un-mixed from the grey paper texture (paper layer is exactly neutral R=G=B so the colour is the logo), mask from chroma + luma, 2 thin ink lines removed (Telea)
files.note: ONLY ~190x150 px, warped/tilted ~35-45 deg by the suit folds, face and ROOMESCAPE letters are blurry; colours are the washed-out poster rendering; use as a reference/inset, not as a production logo

files.title: MONKEY roomescape mark, 3x upscale of the above

context: Two posters (TYLER, SMITH) for the Space Monkey escape room in Granollers - Pau's first project, made when he was 13.
thumb_rule: thumbs are 600px wide (height follows the aspect ratio), never upscaled
colour_note: both source JPGs carry an Adobe RGB (1998) profile; they were converted to sRGB before encoding (colours match what Pau saw in Photoshop)
not_extracted: TYLER sleeve patch: same badge as the SMITH one but multiplied onto textured paper, ~105px wide, crossed by 4-5 thick ink strokes -> not cleanly extractable; the SMITH patch is the clean version.
